obsah:
This Saturday we didn't ride a record number of exhibitions, but we equalled our record for the number of riders from our team plus guests. 

Stráž near Tachov, where the town festival was held, was covered by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Mára Tryner. The festival was relatively small, but with an interesting programme featuring a group of gunners with cannons. You don't want to hear that roar and feel the pressure wave from the cannonade :) The guys were accompanied by our smallest rider, Marty Kabeláč.

A noticeably bigger event was the Zdechovice festival, where Martin Šimůnek, Lukáš Valný and Matouš Balík went for Trial, together with Dalibor Šulc for moto-trial and, as if that weren't enough, parkour athlete Marek from Artmoving. In 3 shows and workshops the guys entertained the large audience of the Zdechovice festival.

And finally, a thank you and a bit of showing off of a new addition to the team garage. Besides a new Crewkerz Trial bike, Vlasta has finally renewed his full-suspension bike after more than 6–7 years. A CUBE frame thanks to our cooperation with the brand of the same name, and complete components from the range of our partner Levelsportkoncept. On the bike you'll find exclusive products from E-thirteen, Spank and DVO suspension. The wheel size changed too, from 27.5” to 29”. Marek Tryner, by contrast, updated his TREK Remedy to the 2022 version. Martin Šimůnek brought the same bike plus a CUBE e-bike.
